# Queen Anne & Magnolia Dispatch

> The Queen Anne & Magnolia Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Seattle, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Queen Anne & Magnolia](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Queen Anne & Magnolia news](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Lower Queen Anne / Uptown](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/lower-queen-anne/): Uptown at the foot of the hill: Seattle Center, the Space Needle, Climate Pledge Arena and the Mercer Street corridor.
- [East Queen Anne](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/east-queen-anne/): The east slope above Lake Union and Westlake Avenue North, with Bhy Kracke Park, the Queen Anne Boulevard and the stairways down to Dexter Avenue North.
- [West Queen Anne](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/west-queen-anne/): The west slope over Elliott Bay and Interbay, with Kerry Park, Parsons Garden and the west side of the top-of-hill shops on Queen Anne Avenue North.
- [North Queen Anne](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/north-queen-anne/): The north slope down to the Ship Canal, with Seattle Pacific University, David Rodgers Park and the Ship Canal Trail.
- [Interbay](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/interbay/): The valley between Queen Anne and Magnolia along 15th Avenue West, with the Interbay P-Patch, the golf center and the rail yard.
- [Lawton Park](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/lawton-park/): North Magnolia, with Discovery Park and the West Commodore Way waterfront along Salmon Bay.
- [Briarcliff](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/briarcliff/): West Magnolia along the Magnolia Boulevard bluff over Puget Sound, a few blocks from the Magnolia Village shops on West McGraw Street.
- [Southeast Magnolia](https://www.queenannemagnoliadispatch.com/southeast-magnolia/): The slopes facing Elliott Bay and Interbay, with the Magnolia Bridge, Smith Cove Park and the Elliott Bay Marina below the south bluff.
